reference_sql:
SELECT ROUND(100 * (SUM(net_revenue_eur) - SUM(units * unit_cost_eur)) / SUM(net_revenue_eur), 1) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM sales
WHERE parent_category = 'Audio'
  AND net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL
  AND units IS NOT NULL
  AND unit_cost_eur IS NOT NULL
